body.zh-HK:
> 面試官問：「一個支援工具同時接收英文、繁體中文和夾雜兩種語言的 case note。團隊說每宗最多 4,000 tokens，所以只要按字數截短便可以。你會怎樣設計 intake contract？」
>
> 答啱一半嘅答案：「中文字通常較短，照字數截掉尾段，留多點 budget 給檢索文件就得。」

## 先分清 token、文字和可用輸入

Token 是模型和 tokenizer 用來切分輸入的單位，不是字、字元或詞的同義詞。同一段內容在不同語言、標點、網址、表格欄位、程式片段和專有名詞下，會切成不同數量的 token。更重要的是，4,000 不是全部給 case note：system instruction、工具 schema、檢索到的證據、使用者文字和預留輸出都在同一個 context budget 內。把中文當成「天然較便宜」或按字數切斷，會令否定句、日期、引用、權限標籤或最後一段問題在無聲無息間消失。

一個較穩妥的 intake contract 會先定義輸入類別，而不是先想怎樣塞滿 window：哪些欄位是任務必要資料、哪些是可摘要背景、哪些屬不應放進 prompt 的敏感內容；每類可用多少 token；超額時由誰決定刪減；保留原文還是只保留引用 ID；以及無法安全縮短時如何交人手。Code-switching 不等於資料壞掉，但它值得成為固定測試 case，因為 tokenizer 計數、關鍵詞檢索和摘要規則都可能在語言交界出錯。

## 行李限重，不是限字數

行李限重不是限字數。一張很短的護照、一個充滿代碼的地址和一封很長的信，重量可能完全不同；而且你還要替回程預留空位。token budget 也是同一回事：先知道甚麼不能遺失，才談怎樣收納。

## 答案在哪裡會變薄

不要一開始就做會改寫原文的 LLM compressor。若產品只處理一種固定格式、少量公開資料和一個短問題，server-side token count、明確上限、拒絕訊息和人工交接已經是更可驗證的 baseline。只有當固定 case 證明真正的內容選擇問題，才加入摘要、檢索或語言路由。

## 技術判斷：把 budget 變成可測的輸入契約

先畫出一張 budget table：system 和 tool 固定保留多少；case note、檢索證據和輸出各有多少上限；哪個欄位永不自動丟棄；超額時的 deterministic 行為是拒絕、要求縮短、只回傳草稿，還是交 review。計數要在實際選定的 tokenizer／模型設定下執行，並把 model version、計數時間和截斷原因留在 trace。不要用「估計字數」冒充已量過的 token。

再加入不只測長度的 fixture：同一意思的英文、繁中和中英夾雜版本；在最後一行才出現的否定條件；含有長 URL、CSV 欄位或 ID 的內容；以及一宗碰到上限後必須拒絕而非猜測的 case。測試的 expected result 應包括保留／排除欄位、token 計數範圍、引用是否仍可追溯和 handoff reason。

## 工程層面：不要讓 prompt 組裝偷偷決定資料處理

把 input normalisation、permission filter、token count、budget allocation、prompt assembly 和 output validation 分開。每一步輸出一個最小、已去識別化的 receipt，例如 content class、source ID、token count、budget policy version 和 decision。這樣你可以證明「超額被拒絕」是 policy 行為，而不是模型剛好沒有讀到。不要為 debug 把整段敏感文字複製進 log；需要重現時優先用已批准的 synthetic fixture。

## 交付、業務與風險：被截短的不是只有文字

產品負責人要決定哪個資料欄位在任務上不可失去，資料 owner 要決定哪些內容根本不應交給模型，support／review owner 要接住被拒絕的 case。成功指標除了平均 token 用量，還應有：多少 case 因上限而停止、哪些語言組合較常失去必要欄位、引用可否回到原始授權來源、以及 review queue 有沒有變成無人處理的出口。這些是交付證據，不是模型分數的替代品。

## 可放進 portfolio 的 artefact

做一個名為 token-budget-intake-lab 的小型 repo，內容可以是：

- docs/input-contract.md：輸入類別、資料邊界、budget table、拒絕和交接條件。
- fixtures/cases.json：完全合成的英語、繁中和 code-switched case，連同預期保留欄位。
- fixtures/rejections.json：超額、缺少任務欄位、未獲授權來源和不可安全摘要的 case。
- tests/budget-matrix.md：每行列出 tokenizer setting、預期 token range、截斷／拒絕結果和 citation requirement。
- docs/decision-record.md：為何先用固定上限而不是自動摘要，何時才考慮增加一個 component。

## 延伸閱讀

[長 context 不是免費升級](/zh-HK/interview-lab/long-context-is-not-a-free-upgrade)、[prompt contract 需要驗收測試](/zh-HK/interview-lab/prompt-contracts-need-an-acceptance-test) 和 [AI engineer 面試能力地圖](/zh-HK/articles/ai-engineer-interview-learning-map)。

## 範圍說明

這是 AI.DOG 的單題練習。情境、資料和 artefact 都是 draft-only 教學素材，使用 synthetic fixture，不代表任何公司系統、語言模型表現、現行面試流程或商業結果。

body.en:
> Interviewer asks: “A support tool accepts English, Traditional Chinese, and code-switched case notes. The team says every case has a 4,000-token limit, so it can simply truncate by character count. How would you design the intake contract?”
>
> Half-right answer: “Chinese is usually shorter, so cut the end by character count and leave more budget for retrieved documents.”

## Separate tokens, text, and usable input

A token is a unit produced by a model's tokenizer. It is not a synonym for a character, word, or language. The same information becomes a different number of tokens depending on script, punctuation, URLs, table fields, code fragments, and domain identifiers. More importantly, the 4,000-token limit is not available only to the case note. System instructions, tool schemas, retrieved evidence, user text, and reserved output all share one context budget. Treating Chinese as naturally cheaper, or cutting by character count, can silently remove a negation, date, citation, permission label, or the actual question at the end.

A defensible intake contract starts with input classes rather than a bigger window: which fields are essential to the task, which background may be summarised, which sensitive material must never enter the prompt, how much budget each class receives, who decides what is removed, whether original text or only a source ID is retained, and how a case is handed to a person when it cannot be shortened safely. Code-switching is not bad data, but it belongs in a fixed test set because token counting, keyword retrieval, and summarisation rules can fail at a language boundary.

## Baggage weight is not character count

An airline's baggage limit is not a letter-count limit. A short passport, an address full of codes, and a long letter can have very different weights—and you must leave room for the return journey. A token budget works the same way: decide what cannot be lost before deciding how to pack it.

## Where an answer goes thin

Do not begin by adding an LLM compressor that rewrites source text. For one stable form, a small set of public material, and a short question, server-side token counting, a stated cap, a rejection message, and human handoff are a more inspectable baseline. Add summarisation, retrieval, or language routing only after fixed cases demonstrate a real information-selection problem.

## Technical judgement: make the budget an executable input contract

Write a budget table. Reserve a fixed amount for the system and tools; cap the case note, retrieved evidence, and output separately; name fields that are never dropped automatically; and specify deterministic behaviour over the limit: reject, ask for a shorter submission, produce a draft only, or send to review. Count tokens using the actual selected tokenizer and model configuration. Put the model version, measurement time, and truncation reason in the trace. An estimated character count is not a measured token budget.

Test more than length. Create fixtures with equivalent English, Chinese, and code-switched meanings; a negation that appears only in the last line; long URLs, CSV-like fields, or IDs; and an over-limit case that must be rejected rather than guessed. Expected results should include retained and excluded fields, a token-count range, citation traceability, and a handoff reason.

## Engineering implementation: do not let prompt assembly quietly decide data handling

Separate input normalisation, permission filtering, token counting, budget allocation, prompt assembly, and output validation. Emit a minimal de-identified receipt at each step: content class, source ID, token count, budget-policy version, and decision. That lets you show that an over-limit rejection is policy behaviour, not a model that happened not to read the text. Do not copy sensitive text into logs for debugging. Use an approved synthetic fixture when reproducibility is needed.

## Delivery, business, and risk

A product owner decides which fields cannot be lost for the task. A data owner decides what must not reach the model. A support or review owner receives the cases that stop safely. Success is not only average token use: measure how many cases stop at the cap, which language combinations lose required fields more often, whether a citation leads back to an authorised source, and whether the review queue becomes an abandoned exit. Those are delivery facts, not substitutes for a model score.

## A portfolio artefact someone can inspect

Build token-budget-intake-lab with:

- docs/input-contract.md: input classes, data boundary, budget table, rejection, and handoff conditions.
- fixtures/cases.json: fully synthetic English, Traditional Chinese, and code-switched cases with expected retained fields.
- fixtures/rejections.json: over-limit, missing-task-field, unauthorised-source, and unsafe-to-summarise cases.
- tests/budget-matrix.md: tokenizer setting, expected token range, truncation or rejection result, and citation requirement for each row.
- docs/decision-record.md: why the first release uses a fixed cap rather than automatic compression, and what evidence would justify another component.

## Further reading

[Long context is not a free upgrade](/en/interview-lab/long-context-is-not-a-free-upgrade), [prompt contracts need an acceptance test](/en/interview-lab/prompt-contracts-need-an-acceptance-test), and [the AI-engineer interview learning map](/en/articles/ai-engineer-interview-learning-map).

## Scope note

This is an AI.DOG single-question practice exercise. Its scenario, data, and artefacts are draft-only teaching material using synthetic fixtures. It does not describe a company system, model performance, current interview process, or business outcome.
